prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
**[goal]** Make all three harness configs give fast-coder a context window of 262144 and keep it that way. Leave every other model setting alone.

**[action]**
- Found the cause: `out/` is generated by `gen.py` from `models.json` (per README), and `models.json` had 131072. OpenCode's file only said 262144 because someone hand-edited the generated copy, so the next regeneration would have reverted it.
- Changed `models.json` (the only source file) to `"context_window": 262144`, then ran `python gen.py`.

**[result]**
- Diff of regenerated `out/` against the old one: only `claude.json` (`"contextWindow": 131072` -> `262144`) and `codex.toml` (`context_window = 131072` -> `262144`) changed. `opencode.json` came out byte-identical, so the generator reproduces it exactly and no other setting moved.
- A search for both numbers now finds 262144 everywhere and 131072 nowhere:
  `./models.json:3: ... "context_window": 262144 ...`
  `./out/claude.json:5: "contextWindow": 262144,`
  `./out/codex.toml:2: context_window = 262144`
  `./out/opencode.json:9: "context": 262144,`
- Assumptions: the source holds the right value now, so any future regeneration keeps all three in step. I took 262144 as correct because you said so. I did not run the install step that copies `out/` into each harness.

**[next]** Run your usual install step so each harness picks up the new `out/` files.
